04 — The DiBi Service

What DiBi Provides

DiBi is a digital business card platform that allows users to create, customise, share, and manage digital business cards. The core features include:

  • Card Builder — design and customise your digital business card with personal and professional information.
  • NFC Exchange — share your card instantly by tapping NFC-enabled devices.
  • QR Code Sharing — share your card via a unique QR code.
  • Wallet — store and manage cards received from other DiBi users.
  • Card Updates — notify selected contacts when your card information changes.

We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of the Service at any time, with or without notice. We will not be liable to you or any third party for any modification, suspension, or discontinuation of the Service.

We may introduce new features, impose limits on certain functions, or restrict access to parts of the Service without notice or liability.

05 — Subscriptions & Billing

Free & Paid Plans

DiBi offers both a free tier and paid subscription plans. The features available under each plan are described in the App and may be updated from time to time.

Free Plan

  • Create and share one digital card
  • NFC & QR sharing
  • Basic card builder
  • Receive cards in wallet

Premium Plan

  • Multiple cards
  • Advanced card customisation
  • Card update notifications
  • Priority support

Paid subscriptions are billed through the Google Play Store. By subscribing, you agree to Google Play's billing terms. Subscription fees are charged at the beginning of each billing period and are non-refundable except as required by applicable law or Google Play's refund policy.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription through your Google Play account settings.

We reserve the right to change subscription pricing with reasonable advance notice. Continued use of a paid plan after a price change constitutes acceptance of the new pricing.
